brief:
Hamas official Mahmoud Mardawi said Palestinian resistance will meet Israeli occupation forces' demolition and arrest operations in Nablus with steadfastness and escalated armed response, Shehab Wire reported. Mardawi characterized the ongoing raids alongside settler militia attacks on the city and its surrounding towns as reflecting the scope of state terrorism directed against Palestinians.

The statement underscores tensions in the West Bank city, where Israeli military operations have intensified alongside continued settler violence targeting Palestinian communities. Hamas has repeatedly pledged to counter what it describes as occupation aggression through organized resistance efforts.
